background: Bank of America Corporation is the holding company of the second-largest US bank, spanning consumer banking, wealth management under Merrill and a global corporate and investment bank.
synthesis: All three of the main agencies rate the group, A+ on average and A- at the weakest of them, all three on a stable outlook, with no rating action since a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 3 May 2023. Capital is thin for the size of the balance sheet: CET1 of 11.2% is in the bottom quarter of US banks and leverage of 5.5% is below the peer median. Liquidity is the same story, LCR of 112% sitting below the peer median, and none of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The flagged items of the last 90 days are share-price and commentary noise, apart from the mark-to-market hole in the held-to-maturity bond book that widens as yields rise, which is the exposure to watch.
